headlines.title: Inflation ticked up in August, setting the stage for the Fed to hike interest rates
headlines.description: Inflation overall in August rose by 0.4% month over month to an annual rate of 3.4%, which was unchanged from July.

headlines.title: Diesel hits all-time high of $6 per gallon and just about everything will cost more
headlines.description: “We are endangering one of the strongest economic pillars that we have in this country,” said fourth-generation Iowa farmer Mark Mueller.

headlines.title: Iran-backed Houthis seize Red Sea coastline, tightening grip on vital shipping lane
headlines.description: The Houthi rebels effectively completed their rapid push to take control of Yemen’s Red Sea coastline on Friday, tightening their grip on one of the world’s most important shipping routes and delivering a dramatic boost to their backers in Iran.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: September 2026 Freebies: School Supplies, McNuggets, More
headlines.description: From free back-to-school supplies to NFL food giveaways, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with a roundup of ways to cash in on freebies for the month of September. Promos include free access to Microsoft software, a Carl's Jr. burger when the Rams snag an interception, a free small bundt cake from Nothing Bundt Cake and more!

headlines.title: Critics say ‘fashion slop’ is coming for the industry’s design creativity
headlines.description: As social media makes trends move faster than ever, some fashion brands are leaning into A.I. and algorithms to churn out more clothes some are calling "slop." NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Apple unveils foldable iPhone
headlines.description: NBC News’ Savannah Sellers reports from Cupertino, CA where Apple’s new CEO debuted the company’s first foldable iPhone. Savannah was one of the first people to get a chance to try out the new device.

headlines.title: Trump escalates trade war with Canada, moves to ban imports of some motorcycles, dairy and alcohol
headlines.description: President Donald Trump moved to sharply escalate the trade war with Canada, seeking to block imports of some motorcycles, dairy products and alcohol. NBC News' Alice Barr has details on the latest economic relations between the U.S. and Canada.

headlines.title: Jimmy Kimmel says show won’t air James Talarico interview on TV, citing FCC threats
headlines.description: The late-night host, who cited FCC threats, said his interview with the Texas Democratic Senate nominee would air instead on YouTube.

headlines.title: Oil prices soar to $108 for the first time since May as bond yields jump
headlines.description: The price of oil surged again, with Brent crude surpassing $107 per barrel for the first time since May as markets brace for a long U.S. war with Iran.

headlines.title: Florida attorney general sues Netflix over ‘bait-and-switch’ on privacy for kids
headlines.description: Florida’s attorney general filed a sweeping lawsuit against Netflix, accusing the streaming giant of misleading consumers about its data collection practices.

headlines.title: Bessent’s move to tamp down rates backfires as bond yields jump, stocks tumble
headlines.description: Bonds sharply sold off and stocks after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s latest effort to tamp down what he called market “fever” backfired.
